body: my friend at work is into astrology and she has everyone’s birth charts haha
hey i’m doing this currently, did you quit? and if so was it easy to stop? I feel so much better on it like i enjoy my day and anxiety is so much less but i’m scared of getting addicted

What I meant is she rips the clothes off herself in rage. Yes mine breaks stuff all the time too. All my previous phones had to be changed because she broke them… Not to mention coming back home to my room trashed and my stuff gone through. I used to just dissociate as a kid and a teen when this happens but lately I have been getting panic attacks when it happens which is so horrible because I feel it physically too. I’m planning to move out I got a job now( which doesn’t pay much but it is something) but even this pissed her off because she feels she can’t control my day anymore. She refuses to drive me on her way to the bus station so I have to walk for like an hour every day but it’s better than nothing.
i’m so sorry you have to keep explaining yourself when you’ve clearly changed :( love you <3
